src/validate.py:
def validate(rows):
    return [r for r in rows if isinstance(r.get("sku"), str) and r["sku"].strip() and type(r.get("delta")) is int]
src/normalize.py:
def normalize(rows):
    return [(r["sku"].strip().casefold(), r["delta"]) for r in rows]
src/render.py:
def render(totals):
    return "\n".join(f"{k}={totals[k]}" for k in sorted(totals))
src/selection.py:
def select(totals):
    return {k:v for k,v in totals.items() if v != 0}
